DNS::is_wideip
Description
This iRules command returns status (true/false) if a string is a
configured wide IP.
Note: This command functions only in the context of LTM iRules and
requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled as part of GTM or the
DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
is_wideip
<
hostname
>
Examples
when
DNS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
DNS
::
is_wideip
[
DNS
::
question
name
]]
}
{
log
local0.
"[DNS::question name] is a wideIP"
}
else
{
log
local0.
"[DNS::question name] is not a wideIP"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
